description.zh-CN: 在岛上列出 fly-island 仓库 docs/tasks 里的没结束的任务：需要你的（等你确认、或只有你本人能做）、认领已失效的、进行中的（谁、哪条 lane）和待做的（在等哪个任务）；有需要你的事时，收起条上显示数量。点一条用默认程序打开任务文件。数据来自仓库里的 pnpm tasks --json，需要 Node。只给开发这个仓库时用，用 pnpm tasks:plugin 安装。
description.en: Lists the tasks in the fly-island repo's docs/tasks on an island page: the open ones that need you (waiting for your answer, or only you can do them), stale claims, in progress (who, which lane) and to do (and what they wait on); the collapsed bar shows how many need you. Click one to open its file. Reads pnpm tasks --json from the repo, so it needs Node. For developing this repo only; install with pnpm tasks:plugin.

description.zh-CN: fly-island 主工作区的路径。留空用安装时记下的目录。
description.en: The fly-island main checkout. Empty uses the folder recorded at install.
